description: This file defines the DaemonToken class, which implements Serializable and provides a token identifier for use in privileged daemon operations within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: DaemonToken
classes.description: A Serializable class representing a token used for elevated privilege operations in the OpenMRS daemon threading context.

methods.name: DaemonToken
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DaemonToken with a given identifier.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier associated with this DaemonToken.
